collaboration.intro: We work with semiconductor companies, design teams and research groups to bring automated layout to their own processes and circuits.

kinds.line: GENESIS set up on your technology: your design kit, your design rules, your circuits.

kinds.title: Design teams

kinds.title: Research groups and universities
